# Pentect

Pentect is a local security boundary for AI coding tools. It replaces secrets
and sensitive data with opaque handles before requests reach a model provider,
then resolves known handles only at trusted local tool boundaries.

Canonical documentation:
- /start/what-is-pentect/
- /start/install/
- /start/quick-start/
- /start/how-it-works/
- /clients/codex/
- /clients/claude/
- /clients/upstreams/

Important behavior:
- `pentect codex` and `pentect claude` protect only the launched client process.
- `pentect codex app` and `pentect claude app` explicitly launch protected apps.
- Handles are references, not plaintext and not authorization grants.
- Unknown provider formats block by default.
- No detector can guarantee perfect secret or PII detection.
- CredSweeper compatibility is measured on named test corpora; it is not a
  general parity guarantee.

Source: https://github.com/EdamAme-x/pentect
